justification: User approved (2026-10-16) rewording OC-18..21 so the outreach gate measures what a planner sees. OC-18 becomes a measured serious-error rate from the hand-labelled address audit (scripts/audit_rate_check.py, merged in #1301); OC-19 is retired as a public claim (its harm is OC-18's); OC-20 and OC-21 are reworded and keep their checks. Address-audit run8 (30 new addresses, 270 rules, labelled by hand) is added as data.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a claim's declared state contradicts its check; OC-18 fails when pooled runs within 30 days have < 500 rules, < 50 addresses, or a 95% upper bound >= 2.0 per 100; OC-19 fails if the retired wording appears on any rendered page
falsifiable_check.observed_red: python scripts/audit_rate_check.py on runs 6-7 only (before run8): FAIL upper bound 2.11 per 100 (6 events incl. unsure / 560). With run8: PASS 1.89 (9 / 830). Gate after: 18 of 21 pass locally, OC-9 unverifiable here only for missing node_modules.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: each serious error is a rule read by a person against the council's PDF page (labels.jsonl reasons); the bound is the exact Poisson one-sided 95% limit

pre_impl.existing_data: audit_rate_check.py and runs 6-7 merged in #1301; outreach_claim_checks.py retired-claim pattern (OC-14)
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: the claims file has mixed indentation; rewritten entry by entry to keep the diff small
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: one retired-claim check; four entries changed

functions.name: no_rendered_phrase
functions.input: the rendered site source files the existing no_rendered_phrase helper scans
functions.output: PASS when no rendered string makes the retired machine-confirmed-land claim
functions.if_none: no match means the retired claim is not made anywhere, which passes

values.value: runs 6-8: 830 rules, 83 addresses, 6 serious + 3 unsure; upper 95% bound 1.89 (severe only 1.43)

break_it.scenario: the audit labels are wrong in the lenient direction
break_it.what_happens: OC-18 passes while users meet more serious errors than counted
break_it.how: unsure labels count as serious for the bound; every label carries its reason and is published for re-reading; the check expires after 30 days

break_it.scenario: retiring OC-19 hides the land-confirmation gap
break_it.what_happens: rules whose land nobody read stop being tracked
break_it.how: DQ-144 stays a ledger row and ratchet; its user-facing harm is counted in OC-18

break_it.scenario: the audit goes stale and the claim stays green
break_it.what_happens: an old rate is quoted as current
break_it.how: newest run must be <= 30 days old or OC-18 fails

mutation_analysis: Removing run8 makes OC-18 fail at 2.11 per 100; declaring OC-18 false while the check passes makes the gate report 'contradicted'.
residual_risk: OC-18 rests on 830 hand-read rules; a planner reading more may find more. OC-20 (DQ-145 1,796) and OC-21 (DQ-146 1,156) remain not yet.

post_merge.secrets: None (audit packets are public addresses and public plan text; grep for keys found none)
post_merge.manual_verify: re-run the address audit before 30 days elapse
